title.narrative: To support the Zambezi River Authority in carrying out the Kariba hydropower plant safety rehabilitation over the next 6 years by: preserving and upgrading core dam equipment, through stabilisation of the plunge pool and refurbishment of the spillway. The plant will then match international safety standards
